about.title: About Me
about.summary: Recent Software Engineering graduate (incoming M.Sc. in Computer Engineering at Kocaeli University) specializing in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic workflows, with hands-on experience building AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex. During my internship at Havelsan, gained deep expertise in technical and ethical benchmarking of modern AI models, including hallucination reduction and model monitoring. Strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C++, Java) combined with practical full-stack and backend skills in Python, FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, and SQL to deliver scalable, production-ready software solutions.
